planner.name: planner/display name
planner.type: manual | importedSolver | temporalAStar | greedy | policy | ml | rl | other

waypointShape.t: mission time number; if absent, derived from window * planningWindow
waypointShape.estimatedArrivalTime: optional planning estimate; recomputed by browser when absent
waypointShape.kind: navigation | surface | samplingTarget | terminalCarryThrough; old plans default to navigation
waypointShape.waypointKind: legacy/display alias for kind when present
waypointShape.segmentEnergy: optional estimated segment energy from previous planning anchor
waypointShape.cumulativeEnergy: optional estimated cumulative route energy for this agent
waypointShape.remainingFuelEstimate: optional estimated remaining fuel after this waypoint
waypointShape.segmentTravelTime: optional estimated travel time from previous planning anchor
waypointShape.currentAssist: optional current alignment estimate for the segment
waypointShape.arrivalUncertainty: optional object with radiusX, radiusY, and angle for the waypoint arrival oval
waypointShape.validity: optional object with valid boolean and reasons array: time | fuel | terrain | stale
waypointShape.warnings: optional array of planning warnings such as blocked route or surfacing reach

waypointSemantics.navigation: commanded submerged navigation intent; not a GPS-confirmed point
waypointSemantics.surface: surface/GPS/communication update point; emits surface_update semantics and can be used for replanning
waypointSemantics.samplingTarget: science objective marker/target; not automatically a hard navigation checkpoint unless converted to a waypoint
waypointSemantics.terminalCarryThrough: final intentional over-duration command; simulation travels toward it until mission time expires

markerShape.t: mission time number for timeline focus
markerShape.label: short display label
markerShape.linkedTargetId: optional priority target / objective id this marker references
markerShape.roiValueAtPlacement: optional ROI/expected value sampled when marker was placed
markerShape.priorityValueAtPlacement: optional priority target value sampled when marker was placed

reachability.availableTime: target time minus connected route-anchor time
reachability.estimatedTravelTime: approximate travel time from current connected anchor to marker
reachability.estimatedEnergy: approximate energy from anchor to marker
reachability.routeRiskStatus: clear estimate | hazard risk | blocked terrain | unavailable
reachability.recommendedBackfillSteps: approximate planning windows/intermediate waypoints likely needed

agentPlanShape.selectedStart: optional {x,y}; validated against the active agent deployment zone on import
agentPlanShape.surfaceSegments: optional segment array used when executionMode is surfaceUpdateBundle
agentPlanShape.markers: legacy optional marker array; import normalization migrates these into top-level planningMarkers

surfaceSegmentShape.waypoints: ordered waypoints for this surface window

executionModeNotes.openLoop: default static route; waypoints execute in order without automatic re-optimization
executionModeNotes.timedOpenLoop: static route with preserved t/window/estimatedArrivalTime metadata
executionModeNotes.surfaceUpdateBundle: metadata and import summary are preserved; automatic surfacing segment application is scaffolded, not enabled
executionModeNotes.policy: recognized as metadata only; arbitrary imported code/models are not executed

planningMarkers: top-level global non-executable planning marker array; preserved by import/export and ignored by simulation/scoring
ordering: waypoints array order is execution order; window/t are temporal planning metadata and are not used to sort imported plans

meta.name: string
meta.levelIdentity: levelId, instanceId, seed, and generationConfig snapshot

notes: Readable schema-like documentation; validation is lightweight/manual. Import normalization fills missing waypoint ids, marker ids, waypoint window/t/action/note, marker window/t/type/label, executionMode, planner metadata, and meta.createdAt. Older agentPlan markers are migrated into top-level planningMarkers. The browser recomputes optional timing/energy metadata when planning state changes. Markers are global planning notes only: they are not connected by route lines, executed, sampled, or scored unless absorbed by placing a waypoint on the same marker cell/time.
